checks.name: All eight authored stages load with independent objects and stable spawns
Jump height varies with release and lands without sinking
Coyote jump succeeds after walking off a real ledge, then expires
Buffered jump fires on landing, including a jump pressed in the air
A buffered tap released before landing produces a short jump
Horizontal and vertical moving platforms carry a standing player
Crumble/reform, vanish cycle, spring boost and conveyor transport work
Checkpoint heals, death costs exactly one life, respawn restores a safe state
Damage grace period prevents repeated hits; falling and lava are lethal
A lethal enemy contact stops the frame before the corpse can collect items
Coins/stars/heart collect once; forty coins award exactly one extra life
Breeze allows exactly one double jump and replenishes after landing
Bloom projectile kills a patrol and action respects its cooldown
Comet produces a brief dash and invulnerability; powers expire cleanly
All four enemy behaviours run: patrol turn, hopper leap, turret shot, pursuing wisp
Completion persists records, opens the next stage and restores from localStorage
A secret opens the bonus early without unlocking late story levels
Inserting a chapter before the finale preserves dynamic progression flags
Denied storage and malformed save data do not prevent play
Boss wakes, alternates telegraph/leap/volley/recovery, and enters phase two
Boss armour rejects damage; a real falling stomp damages its lowered crown
Boss death/respawn retains earned damage and reopens with a clear warning
Lagoon allows sustained swimming and a physical exit onto its higher shore
All mandatory dry gaps have physical walking-jump solutions without powers
Every authored checkpoint respawns above stable ground without immediate damage
Pause freezes simulation and resume clears held input
